title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Design, build, and deploy production machine learning models and pipelines. Experience with Python, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, PyTorch or TensorFlow, and Scikit-Learn. Knowledge of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation in cloud environments.

title: Data Scientist
description: Extract actionable insights using statistical modeling and machine learning algorithms. Proficient in Python, SQL, Statistics, Data Analysis, and predictive modeling. Experience with Pandas, NumPy, and communicating data findings to stakeholders.

title: Data Analyst
description: Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, create dashboards, and drive business decision-making. Strong expertise in SQL, Data Visualization, Power BI or Tableau, Statistics, and Data Analysis. Experience in querying relational databases and reporting.

title: Python Developer
description: Develop scalable backend systems, RESTful APIs, and database services using Python, Flask or Django, and SQL. Familiarity with Git version control, Docker containerization, unit testing, and relational database design.

title: Web Developer
description: Build responsive and modern web applications. Strong command of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, and REST APIs. Experience with Node.js, version control with Git, and frontend state management.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration, and monitoring. Hands-on expertise with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS or Azure, Terraform, and Linux administration.

title: Cloud Architect
description: Design high-availability, scalable multi-cloud enterprise architectures. Deep experience with AWS, Azure, Cloud Computing, microservices architecture, network security, and cost optimization.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description: Protect critical infrastructure from threats, conduct vulnerability assessments, manage incident response, and enforce security policies. Skilled in Network Security, Penetration Testing, Linux, and Cloud Security.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Deliver end-to-end web applications combining robust backend services with modern responsive frontends. Skilled in JavaScript, React, Node.js, Python, SQL databases, and RESTful API architecture.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Build state-of-the-art Natural Language Processing models, text classification, named entity recognition, and LLM applications. Proficient in Python, Natural Language Processing, PyTorch, Transformers, and Deep Learning.

title: Mobile App Developer
description: Design and build high-performance mobile applications for iOS and Android. Proficient in Flutter, React Native, JavaScript or Swift/Kotlin, mobile UI/UX, and REST API integration.

title: Database Administrator
description: Manage, monitor, and optimize relational and distributed databases. Deep expertise in SQL query performance tuning, PostgreSQL, MySQL, database backup/recovery, data modeling, and security.
